title: Pure X-Saber
summary: X-Saber cards with generic staples. M-X-Saber Invoker is Forbidden. The 2026 Terminal World cards lead: X-Saber Pellina, the one-card starter, sends itself to summon two X-Sabers from the Deck; Bruno summons itself, searches a Saber Spell/Trap and Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn; Saber Combination calls another X-Saber whenever one comes from the Extra Deck; and X-Saber Gottoms and Commander Souza are the new Synchros. The classic Boggart Knight into Faultroll swarm still feeds the Synchro Summons, and nearly every X-Saber is EARTH for Gottoms and Souza.
main: X-Saber Pellina
2026 support. Summoned: sends itself to summon two X-Sabers from the Deck; as material, gives double or direct attacks.
X-Saber Bruno
2026 support. Banishes an EARTH to summon itself and searches a Saber Spell/Trap; Synchro Summons on their turn.
XX-Saber Boggart Knight
Normal Summoned: summons a Level 4 or lower X-Saber from the hand.
XX-Saber Faultroll
Summons itself with two X-Sabers out and revives a Level 4 or lower X-Saber.
XX-Saber Darksoul
Leaving the field to the GY: searches an X-Saber at the End Phase.
XX-Saber Fulhelmknight
Level 3 Tuner: negates an attack and revives an X-Saber.
XX-Saber Garsem
Destroyed by an effect: searches an X-Saber.
XX-Saber Emmersblade
Destroyed in battle: summons an X-Saber from the Deck.
X-Saber Airbellum
Level 3 Tuner: discards from their hand on a direct hit.
Saber Combination
2026 support. Summons an X-Saber from the hand or Deck whenever one arrives from the Extra Deck.
Saber Reflection
Reflects damage and searches a Saber or Gottoms card.
Gottoms' Second Call
Revives two X-Sabers next to an X-Saber Synchro.
Saber Vault
Field Spell: X-Sabers gain ATK by Level.
Gottoms' Emergency Call
Revives two X-Sabers from either GY.
Saber Hole
Counter Trap with an X-Saber out.
extra: 2026 support. Level 10: Tributes an X-Saber to destroy a card on their turn; survives by banishing a Saber card.
2026 support. Level 7: searches a Saber or Gottoms Spell/Trap; returns from the GY to take an attack.
Level 9: Tributes an X-Saber to discard from their hand.
Level 6: destroys up to three Spells/Traps.
Level 7: Tributes an X-Saber to destroy what it battles.
Level 5: summons a Warrior from the hand.
Level 7: puts a card from their hand on top of their Deck.
